This application coming on for orders this day, th e co  following:
 ORDER

This is first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of regular bail in connection with crime No.300/2021 dated : not mentioned, registered at P.S. - Kakanwani District - Jhabua for offences punishable under Sections 366, 363, 376(2)(n) of IPC and 5/6 of POCSO Act.
2. The present case is of bail jump.

3. The prosecution case is that on 13.12.2021, the present applicant was granted bail on the personal bond in case no.SC/43/2021 for offence under section 363, 366, 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC and 5/6 of POCSO Act.
That he used to regularly appear before Registry as directed by this Court but on 10.07.2023 his personal bond was seized for non appearance and a non bailable warrant was issued.
On 16.10.2023 an information received that the applicant was in custody in Jhabua for a different case and hence a production warrant was issued against the applicant for appearance on 20.11.2023.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant was granted bail by the trial court but since he was in jail in some other case and therefore, could not mark his presence during the trial.
He was produced before the court through production warrant and since 13.10.2023 he is in jail.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent/state opposed the prayer.

5 . After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the fact that the applicant was already granted bail and,
I am of the view that the applicant is entitled for grant of bail.
6.

It is directed that applicant Paras shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below if not.
7. A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the Ld. Court below.
8. With the aforesaid, the application is allowed and disposed off.
(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE Sourabh Paras vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108030146/
